Hi Redwood sales,

We just spun up a PoC with the self-serve API but our workload has pretty consistent high QPS and tight p95 latency targets. We'd like to talk about moving to a Dedicated capacity evaluation to validate throughput and tail latency. A few quick details:

- Company: CumulusAI (real-time data enrichment)
- Expected steady-state: ~120 QPS with daily spikes to ~450–500 QPS (2–5 min bursts)
- Desired latency: p95 <= 150ms for generate calls (tokenized, 512 seq)
- Data concerns: no PHI, but low retention windows (30 days)

Can someone on your team start a calibration/demo to confirm fit? We can be flexible this week (PDT mornings preferred).

Thanks,

- We're running a quantized Llama 2.1 13B variant (we've been testing both 4-bit and dynamic quant).
- Our infra lead (me) plus one SRE will join the call.
